brand.name: HomeLink Africa
brand.tagline: Amacumbi, imodoka n'ingendo byagenzuwe mu Rwanda hose.

landing.heroBody: Buri cumbi, imodoka n'umuyobozi kuri HomeLink byagenzuwe imbonankubone n'itsinda ryacu i Kigali. Niba biri hano, twarabigezeho.
landing.feedTitle: Byagenzuwe i Kigali muri iki cyumweru

results.addDatesPrompt: Ongeraho amatariki kugira ngo urebe igiteranyo n'ibiboneka koko

gallery.label: Amafoto
gallery.placeholderNote: Amafoto afatirwa buri cumbi kandi ntaraboneka muri iyi verisiyo. Utu tuboneka ni agateganyo.

listing.bedrooms: {count, plural, one {icyumba # cyo kuraramo} other {ibyumba # byo kuraramo}}

steps.inspectedBody: Byasuzumwe hakurikijwe urutonde rw'ingingo 34: umuvuduko w'amazi, umuriro w'inyongera, inzira igera aho, n'igikoni.
steps.photographedBody: Buri foto iri hano yafashwe n'itsinda rya HomeLink. Nta foto yatanzwe na nyir'inzu igaragara ku cumbi ryagenzuwe.
steps.identityBody: Impapuro z'ubutaka cyangwa uburenganzira bwo gukodesha byagenzuwe hifashishijwe indangamuntu. Bikorwa mbere y'uko amafaranga yishyurwa.
steps.escrowBody: Amafaranga abikwa kugeza wemeje ko wageze. Nibitaba nk'uko byasobanuwe, usubizwa amafaranga yose kandi tugushakira ubundi bucumbi kuri uwo mugoroba.

car.inspectedBody: Yasukuwe, yageragezwe mu muhanda, kandi igenzurwa hakurikijwe urutonde rw'ingingo 22: amapine, feri, ipine ry'inyongera, ikoresho ryo kuzamura, n'impapuro.
car.identityBody: Ubwo nyir'imodoka n'ubwishingizi byagenzuwe hifashishijwe icyangombwa cy'imodoka mbere yo gukodeshwa.
car.photographedBody: Yafashwe amafoto n'itsinda rya HomeLink, iyi modoka nyirizina — si ifoto y'ubucuruzi y'ubwoko bwayo.

experience.inspectedBody: Yakozwe yose n'umukozi wacu mbere yo gushyirwaho, hakurikijwe igenzura ry'ingingo 18: umutekano, igihe, n'ibirimo koko.
experience.identityBody: Uruhushya rw'umuyobozi n'icyemezo cya pariki byagenzuwe, kandi bivugururwa buri gihembwe.
experience.photographedBody: Yafashwe amafoto ku rugendo nyarwo n'itsinda rya HomeLink.

status.lowAvailability: {count, plural, one {hasigaye # kuri iyi tariki} other {hasigaye # kuri iyi tariki}}

segment.label: Urareba uri
segment.hint: Bishyiraho ururimi, ifaranga, n'uburyo bwo kwishyura. Ushobora guhindura igihe cyose.

dev.label: Reba nka
dev.note: Iby'iterambere gusa. Inshingano ni iz'agateganyo kugeza konti zishyizweho.

empty.noResults: Nta kiraboneka kijyanye n'ibi byo kuyungurura
empty.noResultsBody: Dushyiraho gusa ibyo twagenzuye, bityo ibisubizo ni bike kurusha uko wabitekerezaga. Gerageza kwagura amatariki cyangwa gukuraho akayunguruzo.
empty.comingSoonBody: Uru rupapuro ruri mu miterere ariko ntirurimo ibintu.

detail.unavailable: Hitamo amatariki kugira ngo urebe igiteranyo
detail.leaseBody: Amezi cumi n'abiri cyangwa arenga bikorwa nk'ubusabe bw'amasezerano yo gukodesha aho kuba ugufata ku ijoro: impapuro, ingwate, n'amasezerano ashyizweho umukono.
detail.houseRulesBody: Kwinjira guhera saa munani, gusohoka mbere ya saa tanu. Nta birori. Gucecekera nyuma ya saa yine z'ijoro, abaturanyi bazabishimira.

quote.chargedIn: Bishyurwa muri {currency}. Bihinduwe ku giciro cy'uyu munsi; umubare wishyurwa wemezwa mbere yo kwishyura.
quote.noHiddenFees: Nta mafaranga yo gufata yongerwaho ku iherezo. Iki ni cyo giciro.

checkout.title: Emeza kandi wishyure
checkout.mobileNumberError: Nimero z'u Rwanda zigira imibare 9. Genzura nimero wongere ugerageze.
checkout.stubNotice: Nta mafaranga akurwaho. Uburyo bwo kwishyura buzaza mu cyiciro cya 2 — iyi buto yandika igifatwa mu byitegererezo.
checkout.escrowBody: Tubika amafaranga yose kandi tukayaha nyir'inzu gusa nyuma yo kwemeza ko wageze. Niba ahantu hatameze nk'uko byasobanuwe, usubizwa amafaranga yose kandi tukagushakira ubundi bucumbi kuri uwo mugoroba.
checkout.noEscrowBody: Ubu bucumbi buri munsi y'urugero rwacu rwo kubika amafaranga, bityo ubwishyu bugera ako kanya. Ubwizerane ku byasobanuwe buracyariho.
checkout.cancellation: Guhagarika ku buntu kugeza {date}. Nyuma y'aho, ijoro rya mbere ntirisubizwa.
checkout.agree: Mu kwishyura wemera amabwiriza yo gufata n'amabwiriza yo guhagarika ari hejuru.

confirmation.title: Wafashe neza
confirmation.body: Twoherereje amakuru kuri imeyili yawe kandi dufungura ikiganiro n'itsinda rifasha.
confirmation.next1: Aline wo mu itsinda ryacu i Kigali azakwandikira mu masaha make kugira ngo yemeze uko uzagera.
confirmation.next2: Amafaranga yawe aguma abitswe kugeza wemeje ko wageze.
confirmation.next3: Ongeraho imodoka cyangwa igikorwa igihe cyose mbere yo kugera — bijya mu rugendo rumwe.

cars.title: Imodoka
cars.subtitle: {count, plural, one {imodoka # yagenzuwe} other {imodoka # zagenzuwe}} i Kigali, zisukurwa kandi zigenzurwa mbere ya buri gukodesha.

experiences.title: Ingendo
experiences.subtitle: {count, plural, one {urugendo #} other {ingendo #}} hamwe n'abayobozi tuzi amazina yabo.

searchPanel.leaseNote: Umwaka cyangwa urenga ni amasezerano yo gukodesha, si ugufata ku ijoro. Tuzagufasha ku mpapuro n'ingwate.

highlight.inspectedBody: {name} yagenzuye aha hantu imbonankubone ku wa {date}, atari ku rupapuro.
highlight.escrowBody: Turayabika, tukayaha nyir'inzu gusa numara kwemeza ko wageze.
highlight.powerBody: Jenerateri iri aho, yakoreshejwe kandi yuzuyemo lisansi mu igenzura.
highlight.fibreBody: Umuvuduko wageragezwe uwo munsi, ntabwo wavuye mu kwamamaza.
highlight.photosBody: Yafashwe n'itsinda ryacu. Nta na kimwe cyavuye kuri telefone ya nyir'inzu.
